items.title: Radiant lists Trace Park in JVC
items.summary: Off-plan JVC residential tower of 228 studio, 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, 296 to 865 sq ft, handover Q4 2026, starting from AED 464K.

items.title: Zoya lists Soréi by Zoya in Dubai South
items.summary: New Zoya project in Dubai South listed on the launch register with studio to 2-bedroom apartments from AED 700K. Payment plan and handover not verified.
